subject: note: Perverse as it may seem, the same might be true of suicide notes: in marking and explaining the decision to end a life, they endlessly outlive it.
note: As Freud writes elsewhere, hate is older…

note: Are suicidal patterns of behaviour best explained organically in terms of neurobiology and, even, serotonin levels? Is suicidality even an inheritable condition within, say, certain families and communities?
